name: FAQ Accordion
description: An accessible FAQ accordion with smooth height-animated open/close, single or multiple expand modes, and full ARIA wiring.
usage: React: import { Faq } from './Faq' and render <Faq /> (or pass items/heading/mode props). HTML: paste the <section> from section.html plus the one-time delegated <script> at the end; it drives every [data-faq] block on the page. Both variants animate with a CSS grid-rows 0fr->1fr transition and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
